dimensions.description: The requested implementation, diagnosis, migration, or verification is actually completed.
Active callers, entrypoints, package/runtime selection, and relevant downstream effects are identified.
Controls and fixes land at the layer that can enforce the behavior.
Fresh checks can reject the material wrong behavior at the required boundary.
Source, process, artifact, runtime, host, and owner claims remain distinct.
Superseded active paths are removed or deliberately retained with an evidenced condition.
The work is sufficient for the target and avoids unrelated expansion.

critical_failures: Stops at a report when authorized implementation is required
Adds a control at a layer that cannot enforce it
Promotes local or surrogate evidence into named-host support
Treats schema validation as effect authorization
Leaves an unintended superseded caller active while claiming migration completion
